name: Web Artifacts Builder
tagline: Create elaborate multi-component React artifacts with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui — complex interactive web apps.
description: Suite of tools for creating complex claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend technologies. Stack: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Parcel + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui. Includes initialization script to set up fully configured projects, development workflow, bundling to single HTML file, and optional testing. Supports state management, routing, and 40+ pre-installed shadcn/ui components. Avoids AI slop aesthetics (no excessive centered layouts, purple gradients, uniform rounded corners, or Inter font).
author: anthropics
suitable_for: Bundling React apps to single HTML
